Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

actiread 0.9.0

  • acti_read(), acti_read_sensorlog(), acti_read_sensorlogger(), acti_read_sensorlogger_location(), acti_read_sensorlogger_general(), and acti_rewrite_sensorlog_csv() take path instead of file, matching the other readers.
  • The SensorLog/SensorLogger readers and acti_rewrite_sensorlog_csv() now default to verbose = TRUE.

actiread 0.8.0

  • acti_read_gt3x() gains a digits argument with default 3L, matching read.gt3x::read.gt3x() and ActiLife (previously it silently read at 5 digits). digits = NULL uses the read.gt3x default. If you resample the data, read at 6 or more digits (e.g. 8L) and round to 3 afterwards.
  • With read.gt3x < 1.3.0, which cannot take digits and always rounds to 3 digits, acti_read_gt3x() only warns when digits is not 3.

actiread 0.7.0

  • Added acti_read_genea()/acti_read_genea_header() for original ‘Genea’ .bin files and acti_read_parmay_matrix()/acti_read_parmay_matrix_header() for ‘Parmay Tech Matrix’ .bin files, with example data (acti_example_genea(), acti_example_parmay_matrix()) from ‘GGIRread’.
  • acti_read() now inspects the first kilobyte of .bin files (and files with unknown extensions) to choose between GENEActiv, Genea, Matrix, and CWA, and dispatches .bz2 and .xz compressed files.
  • tzoffset_to_tz() now returns the correctly-signed Etc/GMT zone ("-05:00" is "Etc/GMT+5") and gives informative errors.
  • acti_read_gt3x(apply_tz = TRUE) now handles non-whole-hour offsets, shows the corrected times in tz (previously a non-UTC tz gave shifted times), and tz = NULL keeps the header’s fixed-offset zone instead of the system time zone.
  • CWA and GT3X readers no longer error on zero-row data or a missing first time; acti_py_read_cwa() accepts tz = NULL.
  • acti_read_cwa_header() uses the fast header parser, and acti_read_geneactiv_header() no longer reads the whole file.
  • acti_read_geneactiv() gains apply_tz.
  • Header acceleration_min/acceleration_max are now numeric for all readers.
  • acti_read_sensorlogger() always returns a list for zip files, and acti_read_sensorlogger_location() uses its column specification and fills missing columns with NA.
  • acti_rewrite_sensorlog_csv() handles quoted fields containing commas and columns after the battery fields.
  • Readers now give a clear error for files that do not exist.

actiread 0.6.0

  • Added acti_read() to guess the reader from CWA, GT3X, and GENEActiv file extensions, including .gz compressed files.

actiread 0.5.0

CRAN release: 2026-08-21

  • Added acti_decompress_file() to decompress supported activity-data files.
  • Added a fast internal CWA-header parser for the Python reader, preserving the native CWA header and appending the actipy processing summary.
  • Reused centralized decompression across CWA, GENEActiv, and Python readers.
  • Marked the optional Python CWA example as \\dontrun{} to avoid Python startup time during package checks.

actiread 0.4.0

  • Adding in ‘GENEActiv’ readers.

actiread 0.3.0

CRAN release: 2026-07-15

  • Fixing bug in setting header if no accrange in acti_gt3x_process_time and acti_cwa_process_time.
  • Added in acti_process_header to normalize this.

actiread 0.2.0

CRAN release: 2026-07-07

  • CRAN Re-submission.

actiread 0.1.0

  • read.gt3x digits argument passed.
  • CRAN Submission.

actiread 0.0.2

  • Added actiread functions to read activity data from a file.
